settings.sources: Unit factors are exact (international yard and pound, 1959). The integrator time step is the pipeline default (SwingBallFlightPipeline flight_dt); 15 s exceeds every reference flight. Bands describe the reference, not the model: the launch-monitor values are means over many shots at tour venues, not normalised to standard air, so carry is held to +-5 %, apex (a smaller, noisier number) to +-15 % and descent to +-4 deg. Bands were set before any row was marked expected-to-fail and must not be widened to make a row pass (#15443).

shots.source: Trackman PGA Tour averages (2019 table), driver: 167 mph, 10.9 deg, 2686 rpm, max height 32 yd (29 m), land angle 38 deg, carry 275 yd (251 m)
shots.confidence: high for the table values (published by the launch-monitor maker and widely reproduced); venue air not normalised

shots.source: Trackman LPGA Tour averages (2019 table), driver: 140 mph, 13.2 deg, carry 218 yd confirmed in press coverage; 2611 rpm, 25 yd apex and 37 deg land angle are approximate, from memory
shots.confidence: high for speed, launch and carry; medium for spin, apex and descent (from memory)
